FN-RJILYNN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 14
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 14 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Governor or Attorney General
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of the salary of any interim police
chief appointed pursuant to this bill. These obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by
any costs recouped from the municipality pursuant to a petition of the circuit court as provided
by this bill.
In addition, this bill could decrease state funding to a municipality that violates the provisions of
this bill by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of funds the municipality would
otherwise have received absent this provision.
Page 1
